title: Round 1 of the diagnostic audition (docs/audio/voice-quality-diagnosis.md, section 3): which model (Eleven v4 Turbo or v4), which text form (full pointing or the plene voice_text), the cheer punctuation, the hum, the stress of "equals", a longer context, and the 32 kbps question. Nitzi, and hero-son for L7.
note: Written by the voice-and-sound-director on 2026-10-29. Every clip is sent with explicit settings (stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, speaker boost) at 44.1 kHz and 64 kbps unless it says otherwise. Listening sheet: docs/audio/audition/listening-sheet.md. To hear another narrator, the director changes defaults.character on request.

clips.text: אֵיפֹה הַפֶּרַח הָאָדֹם?
clips.tests: P1, R1: today's pointed text. ha-a-DOM (red), not ha-a-DAM (person)? Then play the old nitzi clip vo.pick.red.flower.prompt.mp3 (32 kbps, same text): is the new one clearer?
clips.note: caption of vo:pick.red.flower.prompt, the text the old clip was made from

clips.text: אֵיפֹה הַפֶּרַח הָאָדֹם?
clips.tests: P1, R2: the same pointed text on Eleven v4.

clips.tests: P1: the plene voice_text. ha-a-DOM? Compare with L1p-turbo.

clips.text: איפה הפרח האדום?
clips.tests: P1, R2: plene on v4. Compare with L1v-turbo and L1p-v4.

clips.text: פַּרְפָּרִים בָּאוּ לַגִּנָּה! בּוֹאוּ נִסְפֹּר אוֹתָם. נוֹגְעִים בְּכׇל פַּרְפָּר פַּעַם אַחַת.
clips.tests: P1, P2, R1, R5: nis-POR (not ne-sa-PER), be-CHOL (not be-chal), and no syllable-by-syllable reading? Then play the old nitzi clip vo.count.butterflies.3.prompt.mp3 (32 kbps).
clips.note: caption of vo:count.butterflies.3.prompt; it carries ! and the qamats qatan, as the old clip did

clips.text: פַּרְפָּרִים בָּאוּ לַגִּנָּה! בּוֹאוּ נִסְפֹּר אוֹתָם. נוֹגְעִים בְּכׇל פַּרְפָּר פַּעַם אַחַת.
clips.tests: P1, P2, R2, R5: the same pointed text on v4.

clips.tests: P1, R5: the plene voice_text. Does it flow like speech? Compare with L2p-turbo.

clips.tests: P1, R2, R5: plene on v4.

clips.text: פרפרים באו לגינה. בואו נספור אותם. נוגעים בכל פרפר פעם אַחַת.
clips.tests: R1, question 4: L2v-v4 again at 128 kbps. On headphones, are sh, s and ts fuller? If you cannot tell, 64 kbps stays.

clips.text: אַחַת, שְׁתַּיִם, שָׁלוֹשׁ. הַמִּסְפָּר הָאַחֲרוֹן אוֹמֵר כַּמָּה: שָׁלוֹשׁ! עַכְשָׁו תּוֹרְכֶם — לִלְחֹץ עַל שָׁלוֹשׁ.
clips.tests: R5, list pacing: today's pointed hint 3. Is one, two, three calm or rushed? Then play the old nitzi clip vo.count.butterflies.3.h3.mp3 (32 kbps).

clips.text: אַחַת, שְׁתַּיִם, שָׁלוֹשׁ. המספר האחרון אומר כמה: שָׁלוֹשׁ. עכשיו תורכם — ללחוץ על שָׁלוֹשׁ.
clips.tests: R5, list pacing: plene. Is there a small beat at the dash before li-LCHOTZ?

clips.text: אַחַת, שְׁתַּיִם, שָׁלוֹשׁ. המספר האחרון אומר כמה: שָׁלוֹשׁ. עכשיו תורכם — ללחוץ על שָׁלוֹשׁ.
clips.tests: R2: the same on v4.

clips.text: כׇּל הַכָּבוֹד!

clips.text: כל הכבוד.
clips.tests: R6: plene with a full stop. Glad, or flat?

clips.text: כל הכבוד.
clips.tests: R6: the full stop on v4.

clips.text: כל הכבוד!
clips.tests: R6: plene with one !. Glad, or shouting? Decides the cheer punctuation (the director and the editor differ).
clips.note: voice_text of vo:core.celebrate.well with ! instead of the full stop (punctuation only)

clips.text: כל הכבוד!
clips.tests: R6: one ! on v4.

clips.text: הַמְּמ… בּוֹאוּ נִבְדֹּק.
clips.tests: P1, R1: the hum written pointed. A soft hum, or the letters ha-mem? niv-DOK, not niv-DAK? Then play the old nitzi clip vo.core.encourage.check.mp3 (32 kbps).

clips.text: המממ… בואו נבדוק.
clips.tests: the hum, the editor's form 1: a thinking hmmm, then niv-DOK.

clips.text: המממ… בואו נבדוק.
clips.tests: the hum on v4.

clips.text: ממממ… בואו נבדוק.

clips.text: ממממ… בואו נבדוק.
clips.tests: the second hum on v4.

clips.text: שֶׁבַע. שָׁלוֹשׁ ועוד אַרְבַּע שווה שֶׁבַע.

clips.tests: P4: pointed, on v4.

clips.text: שֶׁבַע. שָׁלוֹשׁ ועוד אַרְבַּע /ʃaˈve/ שֶׁבַע.
clips.tests: P4: the one word in IPA. Does Turbo read IPA at all, or spell out letters? (ElevenLabs documents IPA for eleven_v4 only.)

clips.text: שֶׁבַע. שָׁלוֹשׁ ועוד אַרְבַּע /ʃaˈve/ שֶׁבַע.
clips.tests: P4: IPA on v4. A clean sha-VE inside the sentence, with no seam or foreign accent?

clips.text:
פרפרים באו לגינה. בואו נספור אותם. נוגעים בכל פרפר פעם אַחַת.
כמה פרפרים יש על הפרח?

clips.tests: R3, H6: the first half of the butterflies-3 activity in one request (the question, the answer prompt, hints 1 to 3). One warm arc, or does each line restart? Compare its first two lines with L8v-v4.
